responsibility: Implements the ARC-specific gcc driver helper that translates the compiler’s selected -mcpu setting into the assembler command-line options that should be passed to GNU as. Using the arc_cpu_t/arc_arch_t tables, it maps named or default ARC CPU variants onto architecture-family assembler switches and required feature flags such as code density, FP options, multiplier mode, normalization, NPS400, or EA support, ensuring the driver invokes the assembler with a CPU description consistent with backend option selection.
